switches.label: The god's body
switches.help: Whether the god can take a physical vessel at all.

switches.label: Body on waking
switches.help: Take a body as soon as the first mortal arrives (off: it begins formless).

switches.label: Offerings
switches.help: Mortals may hand items to the vessel as offerings.

switches.label: True form allowed
switches.help: Whether the god may reveal its true form at all.

switches.label: Rites
switches.help: Gifts and blessings come with a particle rite and a chime.

switches.label: Custom powers
switches.help: The god may use the custom powers written in config.yml.

switches.label: Server commands
switches.help: The god may run server commands (minus the blocklist).

switches.label: Explosions break blocks
switches.help: Meteors, smiting and blasts may break blocks.

switches.label: "I hear you" sign
switches.help: Mortals get an instant sign that the god heard them, before it answers.

switches.label: God in the tab list
switches.help: Show the god's name and state at the top of the player list.
